sub: 4 prompts that do it for you

cards.title: The 10-line summary
cards.prompt: Turn this transcript into: decisions, action items (owner + date), open questions. Max 10 lines.

cards.title: The follow-up email
cards.prompt: Write a follow-up email to the attendees from these notes. Decisions first, then action items. Under 120 words.

cards.title: Walk in prepared
cards.prompt: I'm meeting [who] about [topic]. Give me the 3 questions they'll most likely ask and a one-line answer to each.

cards.title: The agenda in 10 seconds
cards.prompt: Turn this goal into a 30-minute agenda with timings and the one decision we need by the end: [goal]

caption:
Stop writing meeting notes. Paste the transcript into this prompt instead.

Copy prompt 1, paste your transcript underneath, and that's it. You'll have the summary, the follow-up email and next week's agenda before your coffee's cold.

Save this. You'll want it after your next meeting.

Day 1 of 30. Day 2's tomorrow, so follow if you don't want to miss it.
